arguments.assumptions: FY2027 is a 53-week fiscal year ending the last Sunday in January (Jan. 31, 2027); its Q4 is 14 weeks per the July 2026 10-Q. Six-month FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS reported through Jul. 26 was $4.85. Scenario annual GAAP EPS assumptions explicitly add hypothetical H2 residual EPS of $3.15/$4.85/$6.65 to that reported amount, using a constant-share approximation: bear $8.00, base $9.70, bull $11.50. Bear tests lower accelerator demand or mix/margin and a valuation de-rating; base holds H1 earnings run-rate in H2; bull tests continued demand/mix and higher valuation. These are not guidance, consensus, forecasts, or empirically fair multiples. GAAP EPS includes material other income, including six-month equity-security gains, so the operating bridge is not fully recurring. Hypothetical P/E inputs: 18, 24.1185567010 (equals the dated close at $9.70 EPS), and 28.

cases.rationale: Residual H2 EPS $3.15 is below the H1 run rate, testing demand/mix and multiple compression.
Residual H2 EPS $4.85 equals reported H1 EPS on a constant-share arithmetic basis; multiple is reverse-engineered to the dated close.
Residual H2 EPS $6.65 tests sustained accelerator demand/mix plus multiple expansion.
